authenticity_review: The image maintains a consistent stylized illustration aesthetic without catastrophic structural failures. However, several quality issues exist: (1) animal_pose_auditor reports HIGH artifact risk with 53% of keypoints below 0.5 confidence, indicating widespread anatomical uncertainty in the dogs; (2) Router noted minor wheel/axle misalignment in several cars (severity 2); (3) Dog fur lacks biological texture detail, appearing smooth and vector-like (severity 1); (4) Racing numbers show slight font rendering inconsistencies. These are moderate authenticity concerns that compound across multiple objects. The low-confidence pose keypoints are particularly concerning as they suggest the model struggled with dog anatomy even within its chosen art style.
